burn_window.meaning: The hours read for the burns: an hour before the temple to midnight, since both times are approximate.

event_says: South Louisiana in November can be hot, cold, raining or sun shining all weekend long.
Even if there is no rain in the forecast, pack like there is. We highly recommend a good pair of mud boots.
With extreme weather, the property can flood and make the roads undriveable.
Artwork must be secured against the high winds and intense weather.
Engulf may prohibit or restrict Flame Effects because of burn bans, fire-weather conditions, requests or orders of public authorities.
